requirements.desc: When `flow set init` is invoked, the system shall call `cleanStalePreparingFlows` before listing preparing flows for the warning message.
requirements.note: `flow set init` now performs stale cleanup before warning evaluation, but it no longer calls `cleanStalePreparingFlows` + `listPreparingFlows` directly; it uses new combined `pruneStalePreparingFlowsAndList()`.

requirements.desc: When `cleanStalePreparingFlows` evaluates each preparing flow file, it shall delete files whose modification timestamp is older than `PREPARING_TTL_MS`.
requirements.note: `cleanStalePreparingFlows()` still delegates to stale pruning logic that deletes files where `now - mtimeMs > PREPARING_TTL_MS`.

requirements.desc: When any caller evaluates preparing-flow staleness via `PREPARING_TTL_MS` (defined in `src/lib/flow-helpers.js`), the constant shall equal `60 * 60 * 1000` (1 hour in milliseconds) so that files older than 1 hour are classified as stale.
When `flow set init` emits the `preparing flow(s) already exist` warning, the reported count shall equal the number of preparing flows remaining after the automatic cleanup.
requirements.note: Warning now uses `remaining.length` from post-prune results and lists only `remaining` runIds.

requirements.desc: When a request is handled by any read-only state-observation command handler (e.g. `flow get status`, `flow get next-action`), the handler shall not invoke `cleanStalePreparingFlows` directly or indirectly, so that read-only commands remain free of file-deletion side effects.
requirements.note: Diff adds no cleanup invocation in read-only handlers (`src/flow/get/*`) and only changes set-init/store/manager paths.

requirements.desc: When `flow set init` runs on a `.sdd-forge/` directory that contains no preparing flow files, it shall complete successfully and shall emit no `preparing flow(s) already exist` warning.
requirements.note: Set-init warns only when `remaining.length > 0`; with no preparing files it emits no warning and continues normal flow creation.

unplanned.change: Introduced new single-pass API (`pruneStaleAndList`/`_pruneAndList`) returning both deleted and remaining runIds, beyond explicit requirement wording.
Added new facade method `pruneStalePreparingFlowsAndList()` not explicitly required.
Refactored to combined prune+list path instead of explicit `cleanStalePreparingFlows` then `listPreparingFlows` sequence.
Added spec-process artifacts (`draft.md`, `flow.json`, `issue-log.json`, `qa.md`, `review.md`, `spec.json`, `spec.md`, tests README) not part of functional REQ-P1..P6 behavior.

summary.notes: Behaviorally, REQ-P2..P6 are satisfied. REQ-P1 is only partial against strict wording because implementation replaced the exact required call sequence with a new combined method that achieves equivalent outcome.
